title: El Zeitgeist de la movilidad humana en tiempos de pandemia
summary: To researchers and readers interested in migration issues. We present a set of works gathered under the title "The zeitgeist of human mobility in times of pandemic: direct and reverse trajectories. According to the RAE, it is an expression of the German language that It means "the spirit (Geist) of a time (Zeit)." It refers to intellectual and cultural climate of an era, “spirit of the age” or “spirit of the time”.
